senses.gloss: one who waits to be coaxed, declining.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:3">Ber. V, 3</cite> <he>ולא יהא ס׳ וכ׳</he> in such a case one must not decline (when asked to say prayers).
<cite ref="Sotah 13b:15">Sot. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>הרב … ותלמיד כמה ס׳</he> how rigorous the teacher, and how persistent the scholar!
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 7:3">Ex. R. s. 7</cite>; <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 91">Sifré Num. 91</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 178:1">Yalk. Ex. 178</cite>; a. e.
